name: lumio-games-video
description: Create production-ready game videos and 2D animation assets, with an optional AutoDL/ComfyUI workflow adapter.

interface.shortDescription: Create game video workflows and 2D animation assets.
interface.longDescription: Plan and produce cinematics, character performances, animated menus, in-world loop media, gameplay previsualization, marketing cuts, and prompt-driven 2D flipbooks through provider-neutral, rights-aware workflows, then optionally map jobs to the imported Zealman AutoDL/ComfyUI workflow library.
defaultPrompt: Turn this story beat into a short game cinematic.
Create a seamless video texture for this in-world billboard.
Animate this game menu while keeping interactive UI deterministic.
Turn this character action into a transparent Spine flipbook.
Select and stage a Zealman AutoDL workflow for this approved game-video job.
